description: Planetary phenomena between two dates: oppositions, conjunctions with the Sun, greatest elongations of Mercury and Venus, conjunctions between planets, perihelion and aphelion. E.g. {start: '2026-01-01', end: '2026-12-31', include: ['opposition']}. For almanacs, observing guides and astronomy newsletters: between two dates (up to 366 days, 1800-2199), each planet's conjunctions with the Sun, oppositions (with the Earth distance), greatest elongations east or west (with the angle), conjunctions between planets (with their angular separation and distance from the Sun), and perihelion and aphelion (heliocentric distance), each with a stable key. Matches the published 2026 dates. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.10 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/phenomena (x402 or MPP); always paid, never a free call.
